draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package only reports exp1 on original labels (T1). No label-noise perturbation condition, no robustness criterion application, and no statistical tests are supplied. The claim asserts robustness to label noise, which is entirely unevaluated; no defensible narrower version remains.
